tasks.short: Set marketing priorities, approve campaigns, coordinate delivery and decide what to change.

steps.what: Gather sales, campaign results and customer feedback.
Combine exports and reconcile campaign spending with sales.
Discuss customer needs, positioning and commercial priorities with department leads.
Draft the marketing plan, campaign briefs and proposed budget.

loop.input: Marketing choices, campaign scorecard, brand guidance and plan template.
loop.output: Draft marketing plan and campaign brief with linked evidence.
loop.check: Validate every figure against the scorecard; flag unsupported claims and missing decisions.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; unresolved claims stay flagged for the manager.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates fill budgets and dates, but positioning and campaign rationale require contextual writing.

steps.what: Approve campaign objectives, spending and commercial terms.
Brief marketing and sales leads and resolve delivery dependencies.
Check campaign settings and release approved advertising or promotions.
Prepare a campaign performance summary.

loop.input: Campaign scorecard, agreed objectives and campaign changes.
loop.output: Performance summary separating measured results from possible explanations.
loop.check: Check figures and periods automatically; prohibit unsupported causal claims.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; return unresolved discrepancies without a narrative.
loop.why_not_simpler: Calculations are deterministic; explaining mixed results needs bounded contextual writing.

steps.what: Decide whether to stop, adjust or extend the campaign.

tasks.design: A scheduled integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} joins campaign, sales and spending data from the {ADS}, {MARKETING_AUTOMATION}, {CRM} and {ERP}, feeding a checked {BI} scorecard. A template generator with bounded drafting loops prepares plans and reviews in the {DOCS}; the {WORKFLOW} records budget approval and the marketing lead's release approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Campaign identifiers, spending and sales were inconsistent across systems. Strategy also depended on customer context that templates could not capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing exports and APIs support repeatable reconciliation. AI coding can reduce implementation effort, while bounded drafting helps turn approved choices into usable briefs.
tasks.still_hard: Attribution, brand judgement and commercial trade-offs remain difficult. Audience use must meet GDPR requirements; EU AI Act obligations depend on the intended model use.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a credible position, recognise customer concerns and accept responsibility for spending and public claims.

ambition.what: A fortnightly campaign stop-or-scale decision using reconciled contribution and pipeline evidence.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time assembling plans and more time discussing customer response and delivery capacity. Within an agreed budget envelope, they can gain authority to move spending between approved campaigns.

reach.task: Choose which customer segment deserves additional investment.
reach.learn: Segment economics, contribution margins and how to distinguish experimental evidence from attribution.

evidence.claim: Report summarisation and data questions are supported today; reliable results depend on prepared data models.
Campaign reconciliation, approval routing and scheduled release can use deterministic integrations and configuration.
The digest provides no documented case proving improved marketing strategy or these estimated time reductions.

assumptions: Shares describe an illustrative campaign cycle, including delegated release work; they are not measured customer timings.
The manager works through marketing and sales leads rather than producing every campaign asset.
Build ranges cover one business unit and existing campaign channels.
Access estimates assume a known GDPR basis for audience data; any required consultation follows national rules.
unknowns: Whether campaign identifiers connect spending, leads and sales reliably.
Which existing systems support approval and scheduled release.
The manager's spending authority and the marketing lead's release authority.
Audience permissions, retention rules and applicable national consultation requirements.
research_questions: Which campaign comparisons remain useful when sales attribution is incomplete?
How often do generated briefs introduce unsupported positioning or causal claims?
new_work: Resolve unmatched campaign costs and inconsistent identifiers.
Review generated briefs, public claims and performance explanations.
Maintain budget limits, audience checks, templates and integration credentials.
Record campaign changes so later comparisons remain interpretable.

tasks.short: Direct support departments, resolve competing priorities and hold department leads accountable for delivery.

steps.what: Review department spending, workload and service measures.
Read department reports and identify issues requiring discussion.

loop.input: Department reports, checked scorecard and previous decisions.
loop.output: Source-linked issues, unresolved commitments and proposed agenda.
loop.check: Require a source for each issue; validate numbers and preserve conflicting accounts.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass per report; flag unreadable or contradictory material.
loop.why_not_simpler: Department reports describe risks and dependencies in varied free text.

steps.what: Discuss delivery problems and coach department leads.
Resolve resource conflicts and approve changes in priorities.
Write decisions, expectations and instructions for department leads.
Assign department actions, owners and deadlines.
Chase action updates and consolidate status replies.
Handle escalations requiring cross-department intervention.

tasks.design: Configure shared department scorecards in the {BI} and action records in the {PROJECT}, with overdue exceptions replacing routine status chasing. A bounded reading loop prepares a source-linked agenda from the {DOCS}; structured decision fields generate approved instructions and proposed actions through the {WORKFLOW}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Departments used different measures and reported progress in incompatible formats. Direction and coaching could not be reduced to reporting rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting and action-management features cover much of the work. Bounded extraction can organise narrative reports without delegating management decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting incentives, weak measures and sensitive conversations remain. Individual performance monitoring or trait-based allocation needs separate GDPR, EU AI Act and national consultation assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Judge competing needs, challenge misleading explanations and build trust with department leads.

ambition.what: A weekly cross-department capacity decision before service backlogs become escalations.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time collecting status and more time coaching leads and resolving dependencies. They can gain authority to rebalance department capacity within an agreed operating envelope.

reach.task: Choose the operating model and level of shared services.
reach.learn: Service economics, organisational design and measures that reveal cross-department trade-offs.

evidence.claim: Dashboard summarisation and report questions are available today, subject to data-model quality.
Structured management-paper drafting is an existing capability; it supports preparation rather than managerial authority.
Trait-based task allocation and staff performance monitoring appear among high-risk employment uses under the EU AI Act.
Shared action records can remove duplicate status chasing when updates are maintained at source.

assumptions: Shares and remaining time are design estimates, not customer measurements.
Existing department metrics can be configured into a shared scorecard without rebuilding their source systems.
Action creation uses human-selected owners and deadlines.
Build ranges include access review and an initial consultation cycle where applicable; national procedures can extend elapsed time.
unknowns: Which measures department leads trust and which require manual adjustment.
Whether action status is maintained reliably in the existing {PROJECT}.
Existing delegation limits and escalation thresholds.
Whether the proposed reporting changes constitute employee monitoring under applicable national rules.
research_questions: Which reported measures encourage local optimisation at the expense of other departments?
Can structured decision capture replace narrative instructions without losing important qualifications?
new_work: Maintain measure definitions and escalation thresholds.
Review extracted issues and check missing or conflicting reports.
Keep action records current and investigate stale updates.
Review access rights and reassess employee-data use when reporting changes.

tasks.short: Oversee site sustainability programmes, choose improvements and verify delivery and environmental results.

steps.what: Request site records and collect supplier evidence.
Consolidate site measures and resolve inconsistent units or missing evidence.

loop.input: Supplier invoices, waste tickets and meter records in the site evidence pack.
loop.output: Source-linked quantities, units, reporting periods and evidence exceptions.
loop.check: Require page references; apply deterministic unit conversions, duplicate checks and period checks.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass per document; missing or ambiguous quantities go to the coordinator.
loop.why_not_simpler: Supplier documents vary in layout and wording; structured feeds use deterministic parsing instead.

steps.what: Inspect site practices and discuss practical problems with local supervisors.
Choose improvement priorities, responsibilities and spending.
Write the programme plan, site instructions and proposed milestones.

loop.input: Approved priorities, budget, site findings and existing procedures.
loop.output: Draft programme with owners, milestones, site instructions and evidence requirements.
loop.check: Check budget totals and required fields; link instructions to approved priorities and supplied procedures.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; unresolved safety or regulatory questions remain explicit.
loop.why_not_simpler: Site-specific instructions require contextual writing; dates, costs and owners use fixed fields.

steps.what: Agree site implementation and supplier commitments.
Check programme milestones and environmental measures against targets.
Prepare and approve an internal programme progress report.

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} collects site evidence into the {DOCS}, while a bounded extraction loop and deterministic checks build a traceable baseline on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. The {PROJECT} and {BI} track approved actions and targets; a bounded drafting loop prepares site plans, and a template generator produces internal progress reports from verified measures.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence arrived in inconsistent supplier documents and site questionnaires. Physical practices, ownership and measurement definitions varied between locations.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured intake, document extraction and evidence-linked records reduce collection work. Most tracking and reporting can use ordinary rules once measurement definitions are agreed.
tasks.still_hard: Physical verification, supplier reliability and selecting worthwhile changes remain demanding. Applicable environmental obligations, public claims and any CSRD reporting scope require specialist review.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise whether site practices actually changed, negotiate workable improvements and challenge attractive but weak environmental claims.

ambition.what: A quarterly cross-site waste-reduction clinic using verified cost and waste evidence.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time assembling evidence and more time visiting sites and removing implementation barriers. They can gain authority to fund small site experiments within an approved programme budget.

reach.task: Prioritise environmental capital investment across locations.
reach.learn: Environmental measurement boundaries, investment appraisal and how to assess evidence behind sustainability claims.

evidence.claim: Sustainability reporting software can link evidence to datapoints and suggest reporting answers.
That reporting capability does not demonstrate automated site implementation or environmental improvement.
Document extraction, unit conversion and milestone tracking can support programme oversight with human exception handling.

assumptions: Shares include delegated evidence collection and programme preparation; all timings are illustrative.
The programme addresses operational improvement whether or not statutory sustainability reporting applies.
A sustainability coordinator and facilities lead support the manager.
Build ranges cover a small initial group of sites with agreed measurement definitions.
GDPR and EU AI Act checks apply to actual data and model use; employee consultation follows national rules where applicable.
unknowns: Which environmental permits, reporting duties and CSRD requirements apply to the organisation.
Site count, evidence quality and supplier access arrangements.
Whether measures use consistent boundaries, units and reporting periods.
Who can approve site changes and supplier commitments.
Whether changed procedures require employee consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which evidence types account for most extraction errors and manual reconciliation?
Which proposed measures distinguish real improvement from changes in production volume or site boundaries?
new_work: Review ambiguous documents and missing evidence.
Maintain measurement definitions, conversion rules and evidence links.
Verify that programme actions changed physical practices.
Review generated instructions and investigate target exceptions.
Update programme templates when obligations or site procedures change.

tasks.short: Plan store layouts and displays, test them on site and approve practical changes.

steps.what: Walk the store, measure constraints and observe customer movement.
Gather category sales, stock requirements and fixture specifications.
Sketch options and arrange sample fixtures or display materials on site.
Produce scaled plans in layout-design software.
Walk through a physical trial with store staff and identify necessary changes.
Approve layout, installation spending and disruption arrangements.
Send approved drawings and installation instructions to the delivery team.
Inspect the installed layout and decide whether further changes are needed.

tasks.design: A deterministic generator combines measured constraints, fixture dimensions and reusable layout patterns, using sales and stock extracts from the {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. The {OTHER} layout-design software exports scaled plans, while the {WORKFLOW} issues installation packs from the {DOCS} only after approval of the exact version and recipients.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements and fixture data were often incomplete, while judgement depended on seeing the space. Bespoke layout generation was expensive relative to occasional redesign work.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable constraint checks and plan templates are cheaper to build and adapt. Existing drawing exports can remove redrawing and distribution work without requiring a model.
tasks.still_hard: Sightlines, customer behaviour, aesthetics and physical installation still need site trials. Accessibility, fire safety and other national rules require competent review; geometric checks alone cannot certify a layout.
tasks.human_edge: Notice how the store feels, anticipate staff and customer movement and judge whether a display serves the commercial aim.

ambition.what: A monthly small-zone layout trial with a defined commercial aim and rollback plan.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time gathering specifications and redrawing plans, while site judgement remains central. They can gain authority to approve small reversible trials within agreed spending and safety limits.

reach.task: Choose which store-format changes merit wider investment.
reach.learn: Retail space economics, trial design and how seasonality affects comparisons between layouts.

evidence.claim: Parameterized drawing, geometric constraint checks and template-based layout options can use deterministic software.
Physical trials remain necessary to assess visibility, movement, usability and practical installation.
The supplied digest contains no direct product evidence or documented case for store-layout automation.

assumptions: This task applies to a manager responsible for physical retail locations.
Shares describe a site-led redesign cycle and deliberately retain substantial physical work.
The existing {OTHER} layout-design software supports reusable fixture definitions and scaled export.
Initial scope covers one store format and a limited fixture catalogue.
Aggregate sales and manual observation suffice; access review covers GDPR, intended model use under the EU AI Act and any consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Whether accurate measured plans and fixture dimensions exist.
Which import, export and template features the existing layout-design software supports.
Applicable national accessibility, fire-safety and employee consultation requirements.
Who can approve layout changes and external installation instructions.
Whether sales data can support useful before-and-after comparisons.
research_questions: Which reusable layout patterns produce useful options without excessive manual adjustment?
Which checks can be encoded reliably, and which need a site specialist?
How can a small-zone trial separate layout effects from promotions and seasonal demand?
new_work: Maintain measured plans, fixture dimensions and approved layout patterns.
Review generated options and investigate constraint conflicts.
Control drawing versions and installation recipients.
Record trial conditions, acceptance findings and rollback decisions.

role.altitude: The manager's week shifts from assembling evidence and circulating instructions toward site observation, coaching and cross-department decisions. New decision rights require explicit delegation, especially for campaign spending, capacity shifts and small operational trials.
reach: Chief executive: contribute evidence-backed investment choices across departments and locations.
skills_to_grow: Define reliable operational measures and trace them to source records.
Design small trials and interpret results without overstating causality.
Assess investment, capacity and commercial trade-offs.
Review generated writing and evidence exceptions efficiently.
Understand data access, GDPR, relevant EU AI Act obligations and national consultation rules.
role.ambitious_version: Run a regular operating review that turns verified evidence into small funded experiments, compares outcomes across locations and brings tested investment proposals to the chief executive.
